ops.title: Reduce retired Git administration discovery work preserving active holdings
ops.description: Owner /root/ccx_targeted_stack_io; delegated source owner to follow. Confirmed source internal/vcs/checkout.go retiredHoldings enumerates every top-level common Git admin directory and children probing gitdir/HEAD; preserve arbitrary retired administrative trees, registered/native/reftable state, active-holder precedence and ownership/security semantics. Next: bounded source call/fixture cost proof, then isolated source candidate if existing indexed state can preserve full contract; surface real canonical-authority design choices to root early rather than weaken safety. No new TTL/fallback/compat framework. No local tests/builds/repo scans. No host physical IO attribution claimed.

ops.text: Reproduce actual retired-discovery operation counts on bounded meaningful fixture and preserve exact active/retired holder/registration/security behavior
Frozen independent security/source review plus final-source CI, normal merge/public release
Root-granted install and affected-case measurement prove reduced work; never mark done on diagnosis/source alone
